# Welcome to fastcore

> Python utility library by fast.ai that extends the standard library with powerful functional programming tools, enhanced collections, meta-programming helpers, and utilities for parallel processing, HTTP, XML generation, and Jupyter notebook integration.

fastcore is a foundational Python library developed by fast.ai that supercharges the standard library with a rich set of utilities. It provides `L` (an enhanced list), `AttrDict`, typed dispatch via `TypeDispatch`, monkey-patching via `@patch`, and `delegates` for clean parameter forwarding. Additional modules cover parallel/async execution (`parallel`, `parallel_async`), CLI script creation (`@call_parse`), ANSI styling, HTTP networking helpers, XML/HTML generation, Jupyter notebook I/O, and more. fastcore underpins many fast.ai projects including fastai and FastHTML.

## Guide

- [Contributor Covenant Code of Conduct](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/fastcore/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md): In the interest of fostering an open and welcoming environment, we as contributors and maintainers pledge to make participation in our project and our community a harassment-free experience for everyone, regardless of age, body size, disability, ethnicity, gender identity and expression, level of experience, education, socio-economic status, nationality, personal appearance, race, religion, or sexual identity and orientation.
